name: How do I maintain a natural stone patio?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain a natural stone patio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining a natural stone patio primarily involves regular cleaning and occasional sealing. Sweep or blow leaves and debris regularly to prevent staining. For general cleaning, use a mild, pH-neutral stone cleaner with water and a stiff brush, then rinse thoroughly. Avoid harsh chemicals or pressure washing, which can damage the stone or mortar. Depending on the stone type and exposure, resealing every 1-3 years helps protect against stains and weather, enhancing its longevity and appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain a natural stone patio with regular sweeping, cleaning with pH-neutral stone cleaner, and occasional resealing (every 1-3 years) to protect against stains and wear.
